teaser: You are stacking the last of the clean mugs into the cabinet when you notice the counter has been wiped twice. That doubling is the shape of life path 6 meeting an ISFJ: a number built around care crossed with a type built around quiet upkeep. Six asks you to hold the household, the ward, the gathering, whatever counts as home that week. ISFJ already notices who hasn't eaten, who looks tired, who needs the extra blanket before anyone asks. Put together in one person, the noticing and the duty point the same direction so often that the line between what you want and what is needed gets hard to find.
excerpt: The diner is closing and the chairs are already upside down on the tables.
